name: Sparse Representation Modeling
definition: A generalization of VQ where a dictionary matrix D (R^{m×K}) contains K prototype signal-atoms. Any signal S is represented as a linear combination of these atoms, allowing multiple nonzero coefficients with arbitrary values.
summary: Sparse Representation Modeling encodes volumetric data as sparse linear combinations of dictionary atoms, offering greater flexibility and quality than Vector Quantization by allowing multiple nonzero coefficients.
